scoringUnit: Binary call/fault presence, micro-averaged overall. Multiple faults are separate events. Turn localization is not scored. Layer accuracy is conditional on matched fault ids.

bootstrap.method: Seeded percentile bootstrap resampling whole calls, preserving paired faults. Undefined replicate ratios are omitted. Precision n is predictions, recall n is injected faults, F1 n is union events, attribution n is matched events. Values withheld below n=20.

limits: Constructed transcript and timing fixtures only. Repeated template families are not independent production callers. No acoustic quality, real ASR, live latency or real fault prevalence is measured.
measures: api/_judgepanel.ts provider selection and verdict reduction on blinded call inputs via existing provider request builders. Missing keys, disabled judges, errors and contested verdicts are NOT MEASURED. No judge calibration result without usable replies.

asr-mishear.reason: Comparing generated heardText to generated truth is circular; no independent ASR recognition evidence exists.
